title.zh: 贝莱德与SBI拟合作，探索代币化MMF与日元稳定币JPYSC连接
title.en: 贝莱德与SBI拟合作，探索代币化MMF与日元稳定币JPYSC连接

current_state.zh: BlackRock's financial management and Japan units signed a memorandum of understanding with SBI Holdings and Startale Group to explore linking tokenized money market funds with the SBI-issued yen stablecoin JPYSC, covering technical infrastructure, business model, distribution, and regulation.
current_state.en: BlackRock's financial management and Japan units signed a memorandum of understanding with SBI Holdings and Startale Group to explore linking tokenized money market funds with the SBI-issued yen stablecoin JPYSC, covering technical infrastructure, business model, distribution, and regulation.
